changed_mechanism: Eight independent rays per workgroup, one serial expression owner per invocation, private scratch/status/projection rather than shared storage. This is distinct from the rejected one-ray/one-invocation group.
row_mapping: r=8*g+l, 0<=l<8, original host dispatch groups=rows retained. For each valid r, unique g=floor(r/8)<rows and l=r mod8. Extra invocations return before row writes. Row maximum 65536 and original host group bounds retained; all index arithmetic remains uint32.
full_row_domain_bijection: Euclidean quotient/remainder proves uniqueness and coverage for every integer rows in [1,65536]. Empty inputs preserve original early return.
frame_condition: Private invocation storage replaces all four shared globals. All helper lane values equal0 and serial strides equal1. One owner initializes/writes/reads its entire row, all16 ordered projection terms and every node of each layer. Other rays write disjoint [r*rowWords,(r+1)*rowWords) ranges. No inter-ray collective or atomic remains. Unchanged dispatch completion still owns CPU readback.
